Inverse-distance-weighted interpolation to a grid

Source: R/idw.R
gc_idw.Rd

Plain IDW in one or two dimensions with an optional search radius and neighbour cap; used by plot_map() and plot_section(). Exact at data points.

Usage

gc_idw(x, y = NULL, v, gx, gy = NULL, power = 2, nmax = Inf, maxdist = Inf)

Arguments

x, y, v

Coordinates and values of the data points (y may be NULL for a 1-D problem).

gx, gy

Grid coordinates to predict at (gy NULL for 1-D).

power

Distance exponent (2 = classic IDW).

nmax

Use only the nmax nearest points.

maxdist

Ignore points farther than this; grid cells with no point inside maxdist get NA.

Value

A numeric vector of predictions, one per grid point.

Examples

gc_idw(c(0, 1, 2), c(0, 0, 0), c(1, 2, 3), gx = 0.5, gy = 0)
#> [1] 1.578947
